title: Xanthe and the Autopsy
author: Sable Quintana
blurb: Astrid Montrose, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
